investigations.evidenceSummary: Current first-party KraichgauEnergie mobility page closes the published Stadtwerke Bretten network at 5 stations / 10 connectors (3 stations Technisches Rathaus + 1 Rathaus + 1 Badewelt, each station two connectors). It explicitly offers anonymous ad-hoc without a user account via QR/app and publishes gross ad-hoc prices: 1.00 EUR session fee + 0.54 EUR/kWh + 0.03 EUR/min. The registered-customer time-fee exception is explicitly stated to apply only to registered app customers, so it is not transferred to anonymous ad-hoc.
investigations.coverage: 5/5 published stations; 10/10 published connectors; anonymous_ad_hoc; energy+session+time+payment+gross semantics closed
investigations.promotionRationale: Current first-party deterministic network-wide rule closes every published Bretten station/connector and all required ad-hoc price components without roaming/eMSP inference.

investigations.evidenceSummary: Current first-party page publishes 10 stations / 20 points, states each station has two Type-2 22 kW connectors and QR ad-hoc availability, and publishes Ad-hoc-Laden 0.59 EUR/kWh plus blocking 0.05 EUR/min after 240 minutes, waived 20:00-08:00.
investigations.exactGap: Obtain explicit gross/VAT semantics for the anonymous ad-hoc tariff and confirm that the displayed ad-hoc row is exhaustive for any start/session fee. Do not infer gross treatment or zero start fee from the table alone.

investigations.evidenceSummary: Current first-party page closes the operator inventory at 22 charging stations + 5 wallboxes / 54 charge points and explicitly documents ladeapp use without a charging card. The static numeric table, however, is explicitly the Ladekarte tariff (40 ct/kWh at SWW, DC parking fee after hour 2) and is gross incl. 19% VAT.
investigations.exactGap: Resolve the current anonymous ladeapp/ad-hoc numeric tariff per relevant EVSE/class, including start/time/blocking components and gross semantics. Do not equate the Ladekarte tariff with anonymous ad-hoc.

investigations.evidenceSummary: Current first-party page states 46 public charging stations, all 24/7, all supporting spontaneous ad-hoc via QR without prior operator registration; a first-party 2025 station publication additionally documents QR online credit-card payment and direct Girocard/debit/credit-card payment at a newer AC/DC site.
investigations.exactGap: Obtain the current numeric anonymous ad-hoc energy/start/time/blocking tariff and explicit gross/VAT semantics across the 46-station denominator. Do not substitute roaming-card tariffs.
